question: Resolve the exact Atlanta FRS address/permit identity before reviewing this 2025 air source: register the subject-equipment opacity rule against the default stack rule.

Do not replace ten/forty-percent ceilings or infer a violation merely from an action trigger.

evidence.quote: 1.3 Overall Facility Process Description Finish Mill Production Clinker, finished cement, and other raw materials are received at the plant. Clinker, or cement, along with other additives are ground in two finish mills to produce cement. Limestone and/or slag cement is ground and dried in a separate finish mill system and shipped out in bulk trucks. Particulate emissions from these mills are controlled by baghouses. Specialty cement products are blended and packaged in two packing lines. The finished product is transferred pneumatically to cement storage silos for distribution to customers. Product Distribution Bagged product is distributed by bulk or flat-bed trucks or shipped by rail. Cement is pneumatically transferred from the cement storage silos to bulk loadout stations. The bulk loadout stations utilize baghouses to minimize emissions. The packhouse operation was constructed in 1989 and serves two key roles. First, the packhouse includes a bagging operation in which cement is bagged and palletized for off-site transportation. Second, the packhouse also includes a cement pigment mixing system to produce custom colored cement products. Emissions from the packhouse area equipment are controlled by baghouses.
